scope.description: Whole qpdf application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: PDF page assembly, inspection/repair, object/stream transformation, encryption, optimisation and structural metadata management.

coverage.rationale: Page assembly is a central useful family, but object transformation, encryption, repair and optimisation remain out of scope.

scope.description: Ordered PDF review packets with repeated source pages and clockwise quarter-turn rotations.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Named sources and ordered page selections avoid native command details; publication structure and page choice remain mostly manual.

limitations: Captured unencrypted passive PDFs only; forms, signatures, layers, tags, annotations/actions and unsupported transparency are refused, not preserved.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
